rationale: With only 7 minutes to close, any position opened now faces forced market liquidation at the bell, creating unacceptable slippage risk on a stock that gapped down ~8% and has been drifting lower in the last 5 candles (from 38.02 to 37.66) with no clear reversal signal. The price is below both VWAP ($37.86) and the 9-EMA ($38.08), suggesting continued selling pressure, but the time horizon is too short to capture a meaningful directional move relative to the ATR and spread costs. The account is already down on the day and the risk/reward does not justify entry this close to the close.
